import.error.unknown_format: Unrecognised CSV format. Accepted formats: Bitwarden, KeePassXC, Chrome, Firefox, Keyra, or a CSV with at least a "password" column and a "name", "title", "url" or "username" column.
settings.backup_dir.hint: A synchronised folder is fine: the backup content is encrypted (only the vault name and some technical information stay readable).
vault.category.delete.text.one: Its {count} entry will not be deleted: it will become "Uncategorised".
vault.category.delete.text.other: Its {count} entries will not be deleted: they will become "Uncategorised".
